title: Classic British Apple Pie
description: A traditional British dessert made with a flaky crust and tender apples. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Peel, core, and chop the apples into small pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, sugar, and mash. Add the cold butter and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the dry ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch pie dish and trim the edges to fit.
Fill the pie crust with the chopped apples and dot the top with a little bit of butter.
Roll out the remaining dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch and use it to cover the pie.
Crimp the edges to seal the pie and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Bake the pie for 40-50 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the apples are tender.
Let the pie cool for at least 30 minutes before serving.
